about: Real recording from a MacBook Air (M1), built-in speakers and mic, 18.6 kHz + 19.8 kHz tones from the left and right speaker. Only the ±40 FFT bins around each tone are kept (4096-point Blackman FFT at 48 kHz, 20 ms hop), as signed 8-bit dB. The recorder dropped ~8% of the audio, so there are clicks the pipeline has to reject. Taps are expected to read as pulls (the approach is too slow to see). Swipes are not scored: left/right direction isn't measurable with this mic layout.
